The most effective start at 5 is a "gradual retreat" - sit beside his bed until he's drowsy, then move your chair a little closer to the door each night over 1-2 weeks until you're out. A consistent, short wind-down routine (same order, same time) does a lot of the heavy lifting before you even sit down.

Want the full night-by-night plan to get Milo sleeping solo? Reply YES and I'll send it.
